about: US macro events for crypto research (scripts/macro_events_test.py, docs/research/macro_events.md). Times: FOMC statement 14:00 ET, Chair press conference 14:30 ET, CPI and Employment Situation (NFP) 08:30 ET; converted to UTC with America/New_York DST rules (EDT = UTC-4 from the 2nd Sunday of March to the 1st Sunday of November, EST = UTC-5 otherwise).
caveats: 2025: 11 CPI and 11 NFP releases (October 2025 data of both cancelled after the 1 Oct - 12 Nov shutdown; September releases delayed).
FOMC: 8 scheduled meetings per year; no unscheduled rate meetings 2021-2026 on the Fed page (2025-08-22 was a notation vote on the strategy statement, not a rate decision).
Release dates are taken from the date codes of the official BLS archive URLs (actual publication dates), not from the original schedules.

Exact clock time of each historical release is the standard one (08:30 / 14:00 / 14:30 ET); BLS and the Fed have kept these times throughout; the 2026-02 reschedule reasons come from press reports of a BLS notice.
Price data in the study end 2026-09-09 21:00 UTC; later events are kept as a forward calendar.
sample=extra_2021_2022: older events used only as an extra out-of-sample check (fewer coins have data).
